title: The Next Wave
summary:
crude oil exports likely in 2023
The year 2022 was a perfect storm for U.S. production increased, there was ample export infrastructure in the U.S. Gulf and customer demand (in particular from Europe) was high due to the sanctions imposed on Russian exports.
